findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_metadata, domain_lookup, site_profile, convert_to_markdown · Private data: domain_lookup, base_token_risk, convert_to_markdown · Public sink: kr_trade_exports_10day, kr_trade_pulse, domain_lookup, convert_to_markdown · Destructive: web_metadata, convert_to_markdown.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_metadata, domain_lookup, site_profile, convert_to_markdown · Private data: domain_lookup, base_token_risk, convert_to_markdown · Public sink: kr_trade_exports_10day, kr_trade_pulse, domain_lookup, convert_to_markdown · Destructive: web_metadata, convert_to_markdown

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
